captions: Thursday, 7:12 p.m. The train home. Calendar open.
Tomorrow, 1 p.m.: “Q4 review.” Right over Jumu'ah. Again.
A text from your dad: “Jumu'ah tomorrow? I'll save you a spot.”
You don't write “can't.” You move the meeting to 2:30.
Friday. Snow on the path. Footprints already ahead of you.
At the door, your dad. He saved you a spot.

post.caption:
3 Fridays missed for meetings. Allah called you to all 3. 🤍

The meeting can move. The call to Jumu'ah comes from the One who gave you the job.

“O you who have believed, when [the adhan] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade.” (62:9)

Tonight: open your calendar. Block Friday, 1 p.m. Jumu'ah.
